assets.name: Happy
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one transparent chat sticker for the open-source Project AIRI, square canvas.
Input image 1: official AIRI Live2D character reference; use it for character identity, not for copying the screenshot background.
Primary request: draw a single cute chibi bust of this exact AIRI character feeling HAPPY, delighted closed smiling eyes, a broad friendly open smile, rosy cheeks, both small fists raised near her shoulders in a joyful pose, two small yellow sparkle accents.
Character invariants: pale cyan-blue long hair, asymmetrical side ponytail on the viewer's right, loose long hair on the other side, one large curved loop-shaped ahoge, distinctive angular yellow outlined hair clip on the viewer's right, cyan-aquamarine eyes when open. White jacket with thin yellow trim, navy sailor collar with white stripes, yellow necktie, pale cyan high-neck undershirt. A tiny simple badge rectangle can remain, with no letters.
Style: polished 2D anime chibi sticker, large round head and small upper body, clean bold blue-gray outlines, flat pastel fills with restrained cel shading, simple expressive face; readable at 96px. Establish a consistent production style for a twelve-sticker set.
Composition: character centered, complete head including ahoge and hair clip, hair and both hands entirely inside canvas with at least 8% clear margin, bust ends in a clean curved sticker silhouette. Hands have natural simple chibi anatomy, no extra limbs or fingers. No border frame, no cast shadow, no scenery, no watermark, no text, no other characters.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no white rectangle, no checkerboard pattern painted into the image. One sticker only, no grid or sheet.

inspection.character: Cyan hair, viewer-right ponytail and yellow clip, loop ahoge, white jacket, navy collar, yellow tie match the official reference.
inspection.anatomy: Hands and arms inspected; no extra limbs or visibly malformed digits.
inspection.framing: Complete head and bust; visible-alpha bounds stay inside the square canvas.
inspection.emotion: Facial expression and gesture match the catalog emotion.

Create ONE square 1:1 chat sticker, not a landscape illustration. The entire final canvas must be square.
